title: Remote Control Design and Market Strategy Brainstorm
summary: The team met to brainstorm initial design ideas and market positioning for a new remote control targeted at a 25 euro retail price and a 12.50 euro production cost. Participants suggested differentiating the product through vibrant colors, finder gimmicks like a whistle locator, and comfortable ergonomics. Speaker 4 highlighted the importance of analyzing market potential, competing products, and user-friendliness. Before wrapping up, Speaker 1 assigned specific research tasks to the team to complete before their follow-up meeting in half an hour.
topics: Remote control pricing and profit margins

actions.task: Research competitor remote controls and market potential
Develop design proposals for shapes, colors, and aesthetics
Investigate manufacturing techniques, one-piece assembly, and suitable materials
